serverError.ORDER_EXPIRED: This order has expired. Please register again.

openInTelegram.title: Open in Telegram
openInTelegram.body: Registration and saved runners are available in the WeRun mini app on Telegram. You can still browse events here. You can also log in with your phone number.

phone.intro: We'll send a verification code through Telegram to the account linked to this phone number.
phone.orTelegram: You can also open the WeRun mini app in Telegram — no code needed.
phone.sendFailed: Couldn't send the code. Please try again.
phone.verifyFailed: Couldn't log in. Please try again.
